ch3.mechanism: the profile the bundle's own shape declares
ch3.what: the tag's profile replaced by another TAGGED profile's (the 125M shape's)

stages_false.ch3_reading: CH-3 replaces the tag's profile with ANOTHER TAGGED PROFILE'S -- and the one it substitutes is the 125M shape's.  On the 125M bundle that substitution is the identity, so no refusal can exist.  The control is not applicable at the one shape it names, and it reports fires:false rather than saying so

stages_false.m9_3_reading: FIRST RUN OF THE REPAIRED M9-3 AT 125M, and it fires in all three directions (F, Kv, T) -- finding P-F2's repair is confirmed at the shape the finding came from.  Its ok is false because the control demands a refusal naming the two DRAW counts, and flipping the whole pad STATE is caught one step earlier by the public-table count, exactly as report Sec. 14.7 predicted in writing before this pass landed.  CT-9, which flips the draw arithmetic alone, DOES produce that message here
